connection.instructions:
FileMaker can be hosted two different ways — which one you use determines which fields below you need.

**FileMaker Server (self-hosted):** fill in Host, Database, Username, and Password. Leave the two Cognito fields blank.

**FileMaker Cloud (Claris-managed):** fill in all six fields. The Cognito User Pool ID and Client ID identify your Claris ID user pool — ask whoever manages your FileMaker Cloud account for these if you don't have them.

Your FileMaker account needs the `fmrest` extended privilege enabled (**File → Manage → Security** in FileMaker Pro), and the file must have the Data API enabled for its host.

This connector is read-only — it cannot create, edit, delete, or run scripts against your data.

description: Read-only access to a hosted FileMaker database via the Claris Data API, through the myHub-hosted FileMaker MCP gateway. Search layout metadata, fetch records by ID, browse or filter records, and pull related/portal data. Supports both FileMaker Server (direct login) and FileMaker Cloud (Cognito-authenticated) hosting.
name: filemaker
